Definition: {to smell bad; figuratively, to be offensive morally}
BiblicalUsage: beesh carries the plain sense of to be displeasing, to smell bad, and it shows up only once, in Daniel 6:14.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that beesh is a small window into a bigger truth, and I am glad it is there.
